_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: I hope your dreams are sweeter than candy. I hope your bed is as cool as ice and as soft as a cloud. I hope you wake up refreshed, and you do a big stretch and yawm like in the movies. Goodnight my pookie I love you.
